label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
buildType: performance (not debuggable, R8 off: JNI entry points)
changes: N2: terrain requests no longer wait for the imagery catalogues to parse. Until they are ready a view is planned for terrain only (not cached); once ready it is planned again with imagery, and prediction and idle prefetch start.

N1: overview imagery (zoom 9-12 packs) comes from the edge-cached Worker (bushline-maps.connorgleeson736.workers.dev) instead of the uncached r2.dev address: tiles are cached at the edge for a year, and the whole pack is served with Range requests, byte-identical to the bucket.

N3/N4: each terrain tile's grid is split into 8x8 blocks of 16x16 cells. A block whose own box (its lowest and highest heights, skirt included) is off screen is not drawn, and each block takes the coarsest step (4, 2 or 1) its own error allows under the tile rule (0.6 px, 10 px cells; kept within 0.9 px, 13 px). Block boundaries stay at full resolution, so neighbours always meet. Block metadata is computed when a tile is first drawn, at most two tiles a frame. Default view on real LINZ elevation (renderer/examples/triangle_audit.rs, tools/triangle-audit.py): 840,184 -> 681,824 triangles at 720x1520 (-19%), 864,000 -> 749,744 at 1080x2280 (-13%); the 720x1520 frame matches a full-detail one in silhouette exactly, and with a checker texture differs in 21 of 1,094,400 pixels (sub-pixel edge shifts).
N8: sea-level terrain tiles take the fast path; a zero height still keeps its sign bit-for-bit as before (DemSeaLevelTest).

N6: a baseline profile (androidx.profileinstaller 1.4.0; the app's own code, OkHttp and Okio): assets/dexopt/baseline.prof, compiled at install instead of running under the JIT after each update. R8 stays off.
N7 (decode pools fixed at two threads) unchanged: the audit asks for a device check of the loading diagnostics first. N5 (elevation bytes) unchanged: needs pre-built meshes or a bundling service.

tests.kotlinJvm: all pass: 340 tests, 6 skipped as before (new: DemSeaLevelTest)
tests.rust: cargo test -p ridgeline-core -p ridgeline-renderer: all pass (new core tests: blocks cover the rect once and hide what is off screen; neighbouring blocks share every edge vertex whatever their steps; block profiles flat on planes and bound bumps). GPU examples label_turn and label_occlusion pass (Vulkan, headless).

nativeLibraries: rebuilt for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 (cargo build --release per target, stripped); all three differ from 0.1.73's
sourceNote: Built from this commit's source except that assets/map-defaults.json was written on one line in the APK (same keys and values; reformatted before commit).
